cohort: 52 low-risk nulliparous women with an unfavourable cervix, scheduled for induction of labour for post-dates ≥ 41 weeks gestation
finding: Dilapan-S is an acceptable, safe form of induction of labour in post-dates uncomplicated nulliparous pregnancy.
mod_finding: This study found no difference in cesarean delivery rates between women induced with Dilapan-S and those induced with Propess.
